description: A comprehensive shell script for managing crash dump uploads, including coredumps and minidumps. It handles file processing, compression, blacklisting, rate limiting, and uploading to cloud storage (S3) or crash portal, with support for retries, locking, and environment-specific configurations.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Generates a log filename based on device info and core dump details, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: logStdout
methods.description: Logs each line read from input to the main log.

methods.name: create_lock_or_exit
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or exits if lock exists.

methods.name: create_lock_or_wait
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or waits until it can.

methods.name: remove_lock
methods.description: Removes a lock directory.

methods.name: checkParameter
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is empty and sets default if needed.

methods.name: checkMAC
methods.description: Ensures MAC address is obtained and formatted.

methods.name: deleteAllButTheMostRecentFile
methods.description: Deletes older files exceeding max count in a directory.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up old dump files and temporary files.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and releases locks on script exit.

methods.name: sigkill_function
methods.description: Handles SIGKILL signal, cleans up locks.

methods.name: sigterm_function
methods.description: Handles SIGTERM signal, cleans up locks.

methods.name: is_box_rebooting
methods.description: Checks if the box is rebooting to skip upload.

methods.name: logUploadTimestamp
methods.description: Logs timestamp after successful upload.

methods.name: truncateTimeStampFile
methods.description: Keeps only recent timestamps in the log file.

methods.name: isUploadLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if crash upload rate limit is exceeded.

methods.name: setRecoveryTime
methods.description: Sets a recovery time to delay further uploads.

methods.name: isRecoveryTimeReached
methods.description: Checks if recovery delay has passed.

methods.name: removePendingDumps
methods.description: Removes queued dump files when rate limit is hit.

methods.name: markAsCrashLoopedAndUpload
methods.description: Renames dump as crashloop and uploads to crash portal.

methods.name: downloadBlacklist
methods.description: Downloads blacklist from S3 to prevent blacklisted builds.

methods.name: isBuildBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if current build is blacklisted.

methods.name: logFileCopy
methods.description: Copies recent log files into the dump package.

methods.name: processDumps
methods.description: Processes dump files: compresses, uploads, cleans up.

methods.name: coreUpload
methods.description: Main function to process, compress, and upload crash dumps.
